name: yeet
description: Bidirectional sync between Roblox Studio and VS Code / Antigravity.

yeet.daemonPath.description: Optional override for the yeet-daemon binary path. Leave empty to use the bundled binary that ships inside this extension (recommended for most users). Set to an absolute path when running a custom-built daemon — e.g. `<repo>/yeet-daemon/target/release/yeet-daemon(.exe)` during development. Scoped to user/machine: workspace .vscode/settings.json CANNOT override this, so opening an untrusted repo can never trick Yeet into spawning an attacker-controlled binary.

yeet.debugEcho.description: Pass --debug-echo to the daemon so every hash and echo-detection decision is logged at info level. Useful when diagnosing ping-pong between Studio and disk.

yeet.createTemplate.description: Default set of service scopes Yeet: Create scaffolds into src/. Use slashes to nest under a service (e.g. StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts). Empty array -> no src/ folders generated.

scripts.package: npm run typecheck && npm run build && vsce package --no-dependencies
